1.name: The Magician
1.essence: In the Destiny Matrix tradition, Energy 1 (The Magician) is associated with initiative, curiosity, focus.
1.childPersonality: For a child, Energy 1 may be associated with initiative and curiosity, expressed in age-appropriate ways.
1.parentCue: Offer short projects with a visible make-or-do outcome.

2.name: The High Priestess
2.essence: In the Destiny Matrix tradition, Energy 2 (The High Priestess) is associated with intuition, quiet knowing, observation.
2.childPersonality: For a child, Energy 2 may be associated with intuition and quiet knowing, expressed in age-appropriate ways.
2.parentCue: Protect quiet time and invite feelings without forcing talk.

3.name: The Empress
3.essence: In the Destiny Matrix tradition, Energy 3 (The Empress) is associated with nurture, creativity, abundance.
3.childPersonality: For a child, Energy 3 may be associated with nurture and creativity, expressed in age-appropriate ways.
3.parentCue: Surround with sensory-rich, creative materials and gentle praise.

4.name: The Emperor
4.essence: In the Destiny Matrix tradition, Energy 4 (The Emperor) is associated with structure, steadiness, boundaries.
4.childPersonality: For a child, Energy 4 may be associated with structure and steadiness, expressed in age-appropriate ways.
4.parentCue: Keep predictable routines and clear, kind boundaries.

5.name: The Hierophant
gifts: love of stories and rules that make sense
5.essence: In the Destiny Matrix tradition, Energy 5 (The Hierophant) is associated with learning, tradition, guidance.
5.childPersonality: For a child, Energy 5 may be associated with learning and tradition, expressed in age-appropriate ways.
5.parentCue: Explain the “why” behind rules and celebrate learning rituals.

6.name: The Lovers
6.essence: In the Destiny Matrix tradition, Energy 6 (The Lovers) is associated with connection, choice, harmony.
6.childPersonality: For a child, Energy 6 may be associated with connection and choice, expressed in age-appropriate ways.
6.parentCue: Support friendships and help name choices without rushing.

7.name: The Chariot
7.essence: In the Destiny Matrix tradition, Energy 7 (The Chariot) is associated with drive, direction, courage.
7.childPersonality: For a child, Energy 7 may be associated with drive and direction, expressed in age-appropriate ways.
7.parentCue: Channel drive into achievable challenges and movement breaks.

8.name: Strength
8.essence: In the Destiny Matrix tradition, Energy 8 (Strength) is associated with gentle power, patience, confidence.
8.childPersonality: For a child, Energy 8 may be associated with gentle power and patience, expressed in age-appropriate ways.
8.parentCue: Model calm strength and invite help-seeking as brave.

9.name: The Hermit
9.essence: In the Destiny Matrix tradition, Energy 9 (The Hermit) is associated with reflection, independence, depth.
9.childPersonality: For a child, Energy 9 may be associated with reflection and independence, expressed in age-appropriate ways.
9.parentCue: Allow solo focus time and check in without crowding.

10.name: Wheel of Fortune
10.essence: In the Destiny Matrix tradition, Energy 10 (Wheel of Fortune) is associated with cycles, change, opportunity.
10.childPersonality: For a child, Energy 10 may be associated with cycles and change, expressed in age-appropriate ways.
10.parentCue: Normalize change and help finish one cycle before the next.

11.name: Justice
11.essence: In the Destiny Matrix tradition, Energy 11 (Justice) is associated with fairness, balance, truth.
11.childPersonality: For a child, Energy 11 may be associated with fairness and balance, expressed in age-appropriate ways.
11.parentCue: Practice fair turn-taking and repair after conflict.

12.name: The Hanged Man
12.essence: In the Destiny Matrix tradition, Energy 12 (The Hanged Man) is associated with pause, new perspective, acceptance.
12.childPersonality: For a child, Energy 12 may be associated with pause and new perspective, expressed in age-appropriate ways.
12.parentCue: Allow pauses; ask what shifted in their view.

13.name: Death (Transformation)
13.essence: In the Destiny Matrix tradition, Energy 13 (Death (Transformation)) is associated with change, release, renewal.
13.childPersonality: For a child, Energy 13 may be associated with change and release, expressed in age-appropriate ways.
13.parentCue: Prepare for transitions with stories and small goodbyes.

14.name: Temperance
14.essence: In the Destiny Matrix tradition, Energy 14 (Temperance) is associated with balance, moderation, blending.
14.childPersonality: For a child, Energy 14 may be associated with balance and moderation, expressed in age-appropriate ways.
14.parentCue: Blend structure with play; avoid extremes of pressure.

15.name: The Devil
15.essence: In the Destiny Matrix tradition, Energy 15 (The Devil) is associated with desire, attachment, material focus.
15.childPersonality: For a child, Energy 15 may be associated with desire and attachment, expressed in age-appropriate ways.
15.parentCue: Name wants kindly and practice healthy limits together.

16.name: The Tower
16.essence: In the Destiny Matrix tradition, Energy 16 (The Tower) is associated with breakthrough, disruption, honesty.
16.childPersonality: For a child, Energy 16 may be associated with breakthrough and disruption, expressed in age-appropriate ways.
16.parentCue: Stay steady during big feelings; rebuild after storms.

17.name: The Star
17.essence: In the Destiny Matrix tradition, Energy 17 (The Star) is associated with hope, inspiration, healing.
17.childPersonality: For a child, Energy 17 may be associated with hope and inspiration, expressed in age-appropriate ways.
17.parentCue: Keep hope visible through small, doable inspired actions.

18.name: The Moon

18.childPersonality: For a child, Energy 18 may be associated with imagination and sensitivity, expressed in age-appropriate ways.
18.parentCue: Honor imagination; soothe nighttime or uncertain moments.

19.name: The Sun
19.essence: In the Destiny Matrix tradition, Energy 19 (The Sun) is associated with warmth, vitality, joy.
19.childPersonality: For a child, Energy 19 may be associated with warmth and vitality, expressed in age-appropriate ways.
19.parentCue: Celebrate joy; also schedule downtime after bright days.

20.name: Judgement
20.essence: In the Destiny Matrix tradition, Energy 20 (Judgement) is associated with awakening, accountability, renewal.
20.childPersonality: For a child, Energy 20 may be associated with awakening and accountability, expressed in age-appropriate ways.
20.parentCue: Frame mistakes as learning calls, not verdicts.

21.name: The World

21.childPersonality: For a child, Energy 21 may be associated with completion and integration, expressed in age-appropriate ways.
21.parentCue: Help close loops and celebrate integration of skills.

22.name: The Fool
22.essence: In the Destiny Matrix tradition, Energy 22 (The Fool) is associated with openness, beginnings, trust.
22.childPersonality: For a child, Energy 22 may be associated with openness and beginnings, expressed in age-appropriate ways.
